title: N'Zi Watershed
description: Datasets registered under the 'N'Zi Watershed' Living Landscape (7 item(s)). Spatial extent derives from the canonical landscape delineation (2026-07-21); the simplified boundary is published as this collection's 'boundary' asset. National-coverage member items can widen the extent beyond the boundary.
mosaic:bbox_note: Bbox derived from the canonical delineation shapefile (dissolved, EPSG:4326), union-ed with member-item locator boxes.
